column3: The compact row installs a beforeCompact hook: a threshold compaction whose replaced messages hold a tool result over 2,000 chars and fit 5,000 tokens once each such result is cut to head+tail is placed as that pruned transcript with no model call; anything else is summarized on the owner's utility model, else left to pi
column4: pi 1.5 lets a hook only decline or supply a summary, not edit entries, so pruning is a deterministic summary; the budget is a quarter of keepRecentTokens so the post-compaction context stays well under the background threshold; the utility model moves the summary off the chat model; manual and overflow compactions are never prune-only
column5: plugins/compact/compact.test.ts on the 5x43 KB tool-result transcript: summary requests 1 (12,069 bytes, on the chat model) before, 0 after, placed summary 10,680 chars with head and tail and no middle; prune-insufficient transcript: 1 request of 60,070 bytes on the chat model before, 1 of 60,019 bytes on the utility model after; no utility default still uses pi's request
